author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Today's Stock Market Rallies; Apple Stock Hits New High | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes were squarely higher in today's stock market action after ADP payrolls came in above expectations. Private payrolls grew by 230,000 in September vs. the 179,000 Econoday consensus estimate. Blue chip stock Apple ( AAPL ) set a fresh record high. Meanwhile, Leaderboard stock Nvidia ( NVDA ) fell for a second straight day, as it eased from new highs. (For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today .)
X The Dow Jones industrial average advanced 0.5%, setting a fresh record high for a second straight day. The S&P 500 and tech-heavy Nasdaq both moved up about 0.5%.
Earnings Reports: Lennar Beats Estimates Before the stock market open Wednesday, homebuilder Lennar ( LEN ) reported better-than-expected Q3 results. But shares were about unchanged in morning trade. Shares reached a fresh 52-week low within an over-eight month correction before trimming losses.
Apple stock hit a new high Wednesday. Shares rose over 1% and are nearing the 20%-25% profit-taking range from a flat base's 194.30 entry.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Former leader Alibaba ( BABA ) advanced over 2% after Goldman Sachs reiterated its buy rating on the China-based stock and raised its price target to 247. The price target is a 54% premium to Tuesday's 160.23 closing price amid the stock's near-four month consolidation.
CarGurus ( CARG ) pared losses Wednesday, but was still on pace to extend a losing streak to four trading sessions. The IPO stock leader triggered the 7%-8% loss-cutting sell signal from a short cup with handle's 53.41 buy point Tuesday amid the stock's near-6% fall. The stock is just above its 50-day line, a potential support area.
IBD 50 Stocks: Among the top growth stocks , Nvidia fell almost 1% early Wednesday. The graphics-chip maker hit a new high Tuesday before reversing lower. Rival Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) declined 7%, bringing the stock's overall decline to about 13% for the week. AMD shares are about 21% off high since the Sept. 13 high price at 34.14.
Meanwhile, Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) rose 1% as it searches for support near its 50-day line. The stock is set to snap a six-day losing streak. Shares are in the 5% buy range from a flat base's 219.48 buy point.
Edwards Lifesciences ( EW ) fell another 2% and is trying to find support at its 156.97 cup-shaped base entry. On Tuesday, the stock fell 5% after a pair of analyst downgrades .
